hard_failures: Changed source numbers, denominators, units or mathematical assumptions
Invented observations, variability, novelty, proof verification or sources
Dropped negative results, failures or exploratory labels
Leaked private infrastructure or internal process text into submitted artifacts
Forced a full workflow or repeated whole-suite reviews for a bounded request
Claimed plotting or render success without execution

dimensions.analysis: Explicit question, comparison, evidence, suitable encoding and bounded conclusion; separates expression repair from evidence need.
dimensions.writing: Reader can identify question, contribution, supporting evidence and boundary; precise claim-strength verbs and nonredundant caption/body.
dimensions.implementation: Executable figures/tables preserve denominators, missingness, data identity, configuration and transformation; readable at final width.
dimensions.scope: Uses only needed material and retains the requested research theme.

acceptance: No new hard failures; an observable improvement for each of analyze/write/implement demonstrated with actual before/after artifacts. Optional recommendations only when behavior benefit is inconclusive.
holdout: Separate from task behavior: inspect 30 withheld papers against frozen pattern applicability; record matches, exceptions and uncovered patterns without treating selected status as causal evidence.
